releases.title: Releases

releases.emptyHint: The release tracker polls GitHub regularly; “Check now” triggers an immediate poll.
releases.breakingNoticeText: Please review the changes before raising the target version and acknowledge the release afterwards.
releases.affectedFleetsHint: Fleets whose target version is still below this version
releases.noFleetsBehind: All fleets already target this or a newer version.
releases.gitopsSnippetHint: Apply to the fleet file in the GitOps repository (spec.collector.version).

compare.title: Compare versions
compare.subtitle: All breaking changes and deprecations in the versions after “from” up to and including “to”.

rollouts.title: Rollouts
rollouts.subtitle: Configuration and version rollouts in waves

empty.noneHint: Rollouts are created automatically when the configuration or target version of a fleet changes in Git.

rollouts.wavesHint: Each wave only starts when the previous one is complete (and approved if required).
rollouts.policySnapshotHint: The policy in effect when the rollout started – later changes in Git do not affect running rollouts.
rollouts.readOnlyRole: With your role you can only view rollouts. Actions require the operator role.
rollouts.waitingText: A wave is waiting for your approval before more agents are updated.

pause.title: Pause rollout?
pause.text: No new targets are started; running targets finish.

resume.title: Resume rollout?
resume.text: The rollout starts new targets again according to the policy.

abort.title: Abort rollout?
abort.text: No further targets are started and pending targets are cancelled. Agents that were already updated keep the new state.

rollback.title: Roll back rollout?
rollback.text: All targets touched so far are reset to their previous state (configuration/version).

retry-failed.title: Retry failed targets?
retry-failed.text: Failed and skipped targets are reset to pending and tried again.

approve.title: Approve wave?
approve.text: Wave {{n}} (“{{name}}”) is approved and starts updating.

healthWait.waveEnds_other: Health wait: {{count}} targets, the last one ends in {{time}}

fleets.title: Fleets
fleets.emptyHint: Fleets are maintained in the GitOps repository.

rollouts.title: Active rollouts
rollouts.emptyHint: Rollouts start automatically when configuration or target version change in Git.

filter.attributeHint: Same keys: OR, different keys: AND. Labels: labels.<key>=…

health.noneHint: The agent has not reported a health status yet.

config.effectiveNote: The effective configuration contains defaults added by the collector and expanded variables; differences to the desired configuration are therefore informative only.
config.redactedHint: Values of keys such as password, token, secret, api_key and authorization, header values and credentials in URLs are replaced by [REDACTED] on the server.
config.noneReported: The agent has not reported an effective configuration yet
config.diffInformative: Informative: defaults and expanded variables cause expected differences.
config.diffUnavailable: Both configurations are required for the diff.

components.noneHint: The agent has not reported its available components yet.

rollouts.title: Active rollout targets
rollouts.noneHint: This agent is not part of any rollout right now.

actions.restartText: The collector on “{{host}}” will be restarted. No telemetry is sent while it restarts.
actions.resyncText: The failed hash is cleared, the desired configuration is sent again and the full state is requested.
actions.deleteText: “{{host}}” is removed from management. If the agent reconnects it is registered again.
actions.deleteHint: Remove the agent from the database
actions.deleteOnlyOffline: Only offline agents can be deleted

fleets.title: Fleets
fleets.subtitle: Groups of collectors sharing configuration, target version and rollout policy
fleets.emptyHint: Fleets are maintained as YAML in the GitOps repository under fleets/.
fleets.noActiveRollouts: No active rollouts for this fleet.
fleets.parametersHint: Values this fleet passes to the blueprint
fleets.issuesHint: Validation and render problems from the last Git sync

match.title: Which fleet?
match.subtitle: Checks which fleet an agent (existing or hypothetical) would be assigned to.
match.priorityHint: With several matches the highest priority wins; ties are broken by name.

policy.windowsAria: Weekly grid of allowed maintenance windows
policy.windowsHint: Green: rollout steps may start (local time of the site unless stated otherwise).
policy.noWindows: No restriction: rollouts run at any time.

executors.emptyHint: Executors (webhook/AWX) are maintained in the GitOps repository under executors/.

blueprints.title: Blueprints
blueprints.subtitle: Configuration templates with parameters, fragments and inheritance
blueprints.emptyHint: Blueprints are maintained as YAML in the GitOps repository under blueprints/.
blueprints.chainHint: From the base (left) to the selected blueprint (right); later layers override earlier ones.
blueprints.fragmentsHint: Conditional parts of the configuration (Go template condition)
blueprints.ownConfigHint: Only the layer of this blueprint; the render preview shows the fully rendered result.
blueprints.noConfig: This blueprint has no configuration of its own
blueprints.noConfigHint: It only adds parameters or fragments.

preview.title: Render preview
preview.subtitle: Renders without side effects – with an existing agent or freely chosen attributes.
preview.fleetHint: Optional: use the parameters of this fleet
preview.agentFleetHint: Default: the fleet the agent is assigned to. Choose another fleet only to compare.
preview.overridesHint: Values are read as JSON (numbers, true/false, lists), otherwise as text.
preview.validate: Validate the result against the collector components
preview.placeholder: Choose an agent or attributes and start rendering.

prefetch.title: Prefetch artifacts
prefetch.platformsHint: Empty = server default (artifacts.prefetchPlatforms, else the platforms of the connected collectors)

audit.title: Audit log

settings.title: Settings

system.effectiveHint: Non-secret values of the running configuration (read-only)
system.replicasHint: All active myriarchd instances; the leader runs sync, rollouts and the release tracker.

notifications.title: Notification channels
notifications.hint: From the myriarchd configuration; secrets are hidden.
notifications.emptyHint: Channels (Teams, Slack, webhook) are defined in the myriarchd configuration under notifications.

tokens.enrollmentHint: Supervisors and myriarch-updaters use these tokens to connect to myriarchd.
tokens.apiHint: For automation (myrctl, CI) – fixed role, no CSRF header needed.
tokens.labelsHint: Labels are attached to every agent that uses this token (e.g. pilot=true).
tokens.revokeApiText: The API token “{{name}}” stops working afterwards.
tokens.revokeEnrollmentText: “{{name}}” is revoked. Connected agents stay connected, reconnects with this token fail.
tokens.enrollmentEmptyHint: Create a token to onboard collectors.
tokens.configBadgeHint: Declared in the server configuration (opamp.enrollmentTokens). Revoking it here is permanent: the token is not re-activated at the next start. To issue a new one, change the value in the mounted file.
tokens.secretWarning: This secret is shown only now. Copy it and store it safely – it cannot be retrieved again.
tokens.addHostHint: Use this token on a host: the dialog “Add host” puts it into a ready command. It stays in memory and is dropped when you close the dialogs.

users.title: Users & roles
users.hint: Roles from the group mapping can be overridden manually here.
users.mappingHint: Role comes from the OIDC group mapping
users.manualHint: Role was set manually and overrides the mapping
users.bootstrapManagedHint: The bootstrap admin is managed by configuration (auth.bootstrapAdmin). Role and status cannot be changed here.

section.title: Target version
section.hint: Git sets the frame, the UI chooses the target version within it.
section.notAllowed: No version can be selected right now.
section.upToDate: Already on the newest allowed version.
section.notReachedShort: The target is set but not reached yet. Resolve the rollout first or clear the selection.
section.notReachedText: Not on {{version}} yet: {{count}} collector(s). No version rollout is on its way. After a rollback the host offers the same version again only after its wait time (failedRetryBackoff); "Retry failed" on the rollout is the short way, otherwise clear the selection and choose again.
section.notReachedClear: Clear the selection and choose again
section.holdText: The selected version {{version}} is no longer allowed by the current Git frame ({{reason}}). No version rollouts are started.
section.uiSelectable: target version selectable in the UI within the Git frame

frame.missing: UI updates are not enabled in Git (spec.update.selection).

clear.title: Clear the UI selection?
clear.text: Afterwards the Git target {{gitVersion}} applies again.
clear.textNoGit: Git sets no target version; the fleet has no target version afterwards.
clear.downgrade: Collectors will be downgraded to {{gitVersion}}. The myriarch-updater refuses downgrades of more than one version.

dialog.pickHint: You can pick the versions within the frame Git defines for this fleet.
dialog.waitTimeout: The rollout has not been created yet. It will show up in the fleet's rollout list once the leader has planned it.

summary.title: Summary
summary.supersedes: The running version rollout to {{version}} will be superseded.

error.conflict: The target version has changed in the meantime. The options were reloaded; please choose again.
error.precondition: The update is not possible in the current state (frame, executor or a version rollout that needs attention). The options were reloaded.
error.version_not_allowed: The version is outside the frame that Git allows.
error.downgrade_not_allowed: Downgrades are not allowed by the frame.
error.unknown_version: The version is not a known version of this distribution.
error.reason_required: The Git frame requires a reason.

release.pickHint: For which fleet should the version be selected? Only fleets with an enabled UI frame can be chosen.
release.none: No fleet can select this version in the UI.

versionUpdate.rolledBackNotice: The host rolled back to {{version}} automatically: {{error}}
versionUpdate.noProgress: There is no flow for this target yet.

rollback.selectionActive: The rollout was rolled back, but the UI selection {{version}} is still active.
rollback.selectionActiveStopped: The rollout is not finished, but the UI selection {{version}} is still active. After a rollback the host offers the same version again only after its wait time (failedRetryBackoff).
rollback.clearLink: Go to the fleet, clear the selection

addHost.title: Add host
addHost.intro: Copy one command for each platform and run it on the host. The installer downloads everything from this server and verifies it on the host.
addHost.platformsHint: One command for each platform that you select.
addHost.siteIdHint: Fleets select hosts by their site attributes.
addHost.fleetHint: The fleet that you expect. The server refuses the host if it assigns it to another fleet.
addHost.variant: How the token reaches the host
addHost.variantInlineHint: Quickest for one host: the command writes the token into a private file and deletes it after the run.
addHost.variantFileHint: For production, automation and hosts that record their input: the command does not contain the token, it reads it from a file that you place on the host.
addHost.mtlsNote: Installation with mutual TLS but without an enrollment token is not supported. A server that requires client certificates (opamp.requireClientCert) cannot give install commands.
addHost.shellBash: Run it in a terminal on the host. It starts with sudo.
addHost.shellPowershell: Run it in an elevated Windows PowerShell.
addHost.pinned: Pinned SHA-256 of the installer bundle {{version}}: {{sha}}
addHost.maskedHint: The token is hidden here. The copy button copies the complete command.
addHost.insecure: This server is a development server over plain http. The commands lower the checks of the installer. Never use them in production.

token.title: Enrollment token
token.freshHint: The token that you just created goes into the commands. It stays in this dialog only.
token.name: Name of the new token
token.created: Token created. It goes into the commands, stays in this dialog only and is dropped when you close it. It cannot be shown again.
token.pasteHint: Pasted into the commands in your browser. It is never sent to the server by this dialog.
token.invalid: This does not look like an enrollment token (myre_ and no spaces).
token.noPermission: Your role cannot create enrollment tokens (permission enrollment:manage). Paste a token that an administrator gave you, or choose “Token from a file” and place the token in a file on the host.

warning.title: The command contains the token
warning.text: Anything that records what you type or paste keeps the token:
warning.psreadline: the history file of PSReadLine (Windows PowerShell 5.1)
warning.recording: the recording of a terminal session
warning.leaked: A token that one of these kept counts as leaked: revoke it. On a host that records its input, use “Token from a file”.

state.disabled: Installing hosts from the server is turned off on this server (install.enabled).
state.noBundleTitle: This server has no installer bundles
state.noBundleText: It is a local build and not a release of the project. Install the host with the manual path, or run a release of myriarchd.

localBuild.title: This server is a local build
localBuild.text: A local build has no installer bundle, so it cannot give install commands.
localBuild.next: Use the manual path of the guide “Connect a host”, or run a release of myriarchd.

serverSettings.title: The server cannot give install commands
serverSettings.text: The server refused the request because of its own settings. A common cause is that the client certificates are required (opamp.requireClientCert; installation with mutual TLS but without a token is not supported). Another is that server.publicUrl is missing, is not an https address or has credentials, a query or characters that a command cannot carry.
serverSettings.next: Read the message of the server below, ask the operator to correct that setting, or use the manual path of the guide “Connect a host”.

preparing.title: The installer bundles are being prepared
preparing.text: The server is fetching and verifying the installer bundles of its release.
preparing.next: Wait a moment and try again.

bundleFailed.title: An installer bundle failed
bundleFailed.text: The server could not prepare the bundle. It tries again after a minute.
bundleFailed.next: Try again later, or ask the operator to check the connection to install.bundleSourceBaseUrl.

platformNotSupported.title: A platform is not supported
platformNotSupported.text: This server does not offer an installer for one of the selected platforms.
platformNotSupported.next: Deselect that platform and try again.

variantNotAvailable.title: This variant is not available
variantNotAvailable.text: The variant “lab” (plain http) exists on development servers only.
variantNotAvailable.next: Choose “Token in the command” or “Token from a file”.

disabled.title: Installing hosts from the server is turned off
disabled.text: The server does not give install commands (install.enabled is false).
disabled.next: Use the manual path of the guide “Connect a host”.

conflict.title: The request conflicts with the state of the server
conflict.text: The state of the server changed while you worked.
conflict.next: Close the dialog, open it again and repeat the steps.
